clusters.pick_reason: PR #1617 positively resolves the use case by detecting plain JSON Schema via `isLikelyJsonSchema()` and passing it through unchanged, maintaining backwards compatibility with the deprecated overload. It also correctly widens the `inputSchema` type signature. PR #1596 takes the opposite approach — throwing an error on plain JSON Schema — which would be a breaking change for users already relying on this pattern, and conflicts directly with #1617's permissive handling of the same code path.
